title: "Resources"

The [Reading](reading.qmd) page lists papers. This page lists everything else:
the software you would actually run, the courses you could actually enrol in,
the regulatory guidances that tell you what a deliverable must contain, the
repositories where a runnable model or a real dataset can be downloaded, and the
databases you consult when you need a fact about a drug.

The source of truth is [`resources.csv`](https://github.com/mgl0619/modelers-bench/blob/main/resources.csv)
in this repository — one row per resource, plain text, diffable, and validated
by `scripts/check_resources.py`. This page is generated from it. To add a
resource, add a row and open a pull request.

::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}
## How these were checked, and what that does and does not guarantee

**Every URL in this table was fetched and confirmed before the row was written**,
and the `cost` and `licence` fields were read off the page rather than recalled.
That matters most where the answer is counterintuitive: Open Systems Pharmacology
is genuinely free for commercial use, KEGG is explicitly *not* a public database,
and DrugBank requires a licence for any redistribution of its content.

What this does **not** guarantee: that a link is still live today, that a price
has not changed, or that a description is right about something the page did not
say. Where a page was silent, the field says `unknown` rather than a guess —
there are more `unknown` licences here than we would like, and each one is a real
gap, not a formatting choice.

If a row is wrong, that is a bug. Open an issue.
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import csv, html, json
from pathlib import Path

CSV = Path("resources.csv")
rows = list(csv.DictReader(CSV.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="")))

CATEGORY_ORDER = ["guidance", "software", "repository", "reference", "course"]
CATEGORY_LABEL = {
    "guidance":   "Regulatory guidance",
    "software":   "Software and packages",
    "repository": "Model repositories and datasets",
    "reference":  "Reference databases",
    "course":     "Courses, training and societies",
}
CATEGORY_BLURB = {
    "guidance":   "All free, all public, and mostly short. These state what a "
                  "deliverable must contain — which makes them the most "
                  "specific description of the job available anywhere.",
    "software":   "The cost column is the one to read first. A great deal of "
                  "population PK can be done for nothing; PBPK used to be the "
                  "exception until Open Systems Pharmacology.",
    "repository": "Places to get a runnable model or a real dataset without "
                  "asking anyone's permission.",
    "reference":  "Lookup resources. Read the licence column before you copy "
                  "anything out of them into your own work.",
    "course":     "Ordered so that the things a person with no budget and no "
                  "institution can start tonight come first.",
}
COST_LABEL = {
    "free": "free", "free-academic": "free for academics",
    "freemium": "free tier", "commercial": "paid", "unknown": "cost unstated",
}

n_free = sum(1 for r in rows if r["cost"] in ("free", "free-academic"))
verified = sorted({r["verified"] for r in rows})[-1]

print(f"**{len(rows)} resources**, of which **{n_free}** are usable at no cost. "
      f"Links last verified {verified}.\n")

# --- filter UI -------------------------------------------------------------
print("""
<div class="res-controls">
  <input type="search" id="res-q" placeholder="Search name, description, maintainer…" aria-label="Search resources">
  <span class="res-chips" id="res-domains"></span>
  <label class="res-freeonly"><input type="checkbox" id="res-free"> free only</label>
  <span class="res-count" id="res-count"></span>
</div>
""")

DOMAIN_LABEL = {
    "pharmacology": "pharmacology", "pkpd": "PK/PD", "poppk": "PopPK",
    "pbpk": "PBPK", "qsp": "QSP", "stats-ml": "stats & ML",
    "regulatory": "regulatory", "general": "general",
}

def esc(s):
    return html.escape(s or "")

for cat in CATEGORY_ORDER:
    group = [r for r in rows if r["category"] == cat]
    if not group:
        continue
    print(f'\n<h2 class="res-h" data-cat="{cat}">{CATEGORY_LABEL[cat]} '
          f'<span class="res-n">{len(group)}</span></h2>')
    print(f'<p class="res-blurb">{esc(CATEGORY_BLURB[cat])}</p>')

    subs = []
    for r in group:
        if r["subcategory"] not in subs:
            subs.append(r["subcategory"])

    for sub in subs:
        items = [r for r in group if r["subcategory"] == sub]
        print(f'<h3 class="res-sub">{esc(sub)}</h3>')
        print('<div class="res-list">')
        for r in items:
            doms = r["domains"].split("|")
            blob = " ".join([r["name"], r["description"], r["best_for"],
                             r["maintainer"], r["notes"], r["licence"]]).lower()
            free = "1" if r["cost"] in ("free", "free-academic") else "0"
            print(f'''<div class="res-item" data-domains="{esc(r["domains"])}" data-free="{free}" data-blob="{esc(blob)}">
  <div class="res-head">
    <a class="res-name" href="{esc(r["url"])}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{esc(r["name"])}</a>
    <span class="res-cost res-cost-{esc(r["cost"])}">{esc(COST_LABEL[r["cost"]])}</span>
  </div>
  <div class="res-meta">{esc(r["maintainer"])}{" &middot; " + esc(r["language"]) if r["language"] not in ("n/a", "") else ""} &middot; <span class="res-lic">{esc(r["licence"])}</span></div>
  <p class="res-desc">{esc(r["description"])}</p>
  <p class="res-use"><strong>Use it for:</strong> {esc(r["best_for"])}</p>
  {f'<p class="res-note">{esc(r["notes"])}</p>' if r["notes"] else ""}
  <div class="res-doms">{"".join(f'<span class="res-dom">{DOMAIN_LABEL.get(d, d)}</span>' for d in doms)}</div>
</div>''')
        print('</div>')

print(f"\n<script>window.RES_DOMAINS = {json.dumps(DOMAIN_LABEL)};</script>")
```

@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){
  .res-cost-free,.res-cost-free-academic{color:#5fbf90}

</style>
<script>
(function(){
  var items=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.res-item'));
  if(!items.length) return;
  var q=document.getElementById('res-q'),
      freeBox=document.getElementById('res-free'),
      chipBox=document.getElementById('res-domains'),
      countEl=document.getElementById('res-count'),
      labels=window.RES_DOMAINS||{}, active=new Set();

  var present=[];
  items.forEach(function(el){
    el.dataset.domains.split('|').forEach(function(d){
      if(present.indexOf(d)<0) present.push(d);
    });
  });
  present.forEach(function(d){
    var b=document.createElement('button');
    b.className='res-chip'; b.type='button'; b.textContent=labels[d]||d;
    b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){
      if(active.has(d)){active.delete(d);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');}
      else{active.add(d);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');}
      apply();
    });
    chipBox.appendChild(b);
  });

  function apply(){
    var term=(q.value||'').trim().toLowerCase(),
        onlyFree=freeBox.checked, shown=0;
    items.forEach(function(el){
      var ok=true;
      if(term && el.dataset.blob.indexOf(term)<0) ok=false;
      if(ok && onlyFree && el.dataset.free!=='1') ok=false;
      if(ok && active.size){
        var ds=el.dataset.domains.split('|'), hit=false;
        active.forEach(function(d){ if(ds.indexOf(d)>=0) hit=true; });
        if(!hit) ok=false;
      }
      el.hidden=!ok; if(ok) shown++;
    });
    // hide a subsection heading and its list when nothing in it survives
    [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.res-list')).forEach(function(list){
      var any=[].slice.call(list.querySelectorAll('.res-item')).some(function(e){return !e.hidden;});
      list.style.display=any?'':'none';
      var h=list.previousElementSibling;
      if(h&&h.classList.contains('res-sub')) h.style.display=any?'':'none';
    });
    countEl.textContent=shown+' of '+items.length+' shown';
  }
  q.addEventListener('input',apply);
  freeBox.addEventListener('change',apply);
  apply();
})();
</script>

## Where these are used in the curriculum

The database is not meant to be read straight through. Each strand pulls from it:

| Page | What it pulls |
|---|---|
| [S0-00 · What quantitative pharmacology is](lessons/s0-00-what-is-qp/index.qmd) | The free courses a twelve-month self-study route can be built from |
| [S0-03 · Data assembly](lessons/s0-03-data-assembly/index.qmd) | Real datasets to practise on once `CASE-SM` stops surprising you |
| [S0-04 · Choosing a stack](lessons/s0-04-choosing-a-stack/index.qmd) | The whole software table, priced, with a free-only column |
| [S0-06 · Reading a model report](lessons/s0-06-reading-a-model-report/index.qmd) | FDA, EMA and ICH M15 — the review checklists written by the people who review |
| [Strand P · Pharmacology](pharmacology.qmd) | Lecture courses, target databases, label archives and PBPK parameter sources |
| [Cases](cases.qmd) | Model repositories, for when synthetic data has taught you what it can |

## What is deliberately not here

- **Anything we could not fetch.** Around twenty candidates were dropped because
  a URL 404'd, redirected somewhere unrelated, or returned a JavaScript shell
  with no readable content. A few are real resources that simply could not be
  verified from their own page — PharmGKB and the Therapeutic Target Database
  among them — and they are omitted rather than described from memory.
- **Anything defunct presented as current.** The DDMoRe Model Repository is
  listed because its models are still downloadable, but its row says plainly
  that every date signal on the site stops in 2018.
- **Textbooks.** Rowland & Tozer, Gabrielsson & Weiner and Rang & Dale are each
  worth owning. None has a canonical free page to link, so none is here.
- **Prices, mostly.** Very few vendors publish them. Where a page stated a
  figure — Manchester's MSc fees, Certara University's course range — the row
  says so; everywhere else it says pricing is not published, which is itself
  information.
